basic_details.job_title: IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager (Research & Development) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Office of Research & Development (Dean of Research and Development), Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, is filling 4 Assistant Project Manager posts on a purely temporary and contractual basis for one year, which may be extended based on requirement. The consolidated pay is Rs. 16000-1300-38000/- p.m. based on qualification and experience. Applicants need a post graduate degree OR a graduate degree with 03 years of relevant experience, and must be at most 32 years old. Applications go through a Google form until 20 November 2026, 5:00 PM (advertisement no. P.Rect./R&D/2026/221).

age_limit.details: The age limit is maximum 32 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. It states the age relaxation as "50 years for employees working in projects and work assignment of IIT Kanpur". | The notice does not name the degree subject. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

how_to_apply: The notice asks candidates to apply on the Google form link it gives. The last date for submission of the online application is 20 November 2026, up to 05:00 PM. The notice does not list any documents to attach.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be informed. Candidates with experience in PFMS, Finance & Accounts, Purchase & Project Management will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: One year, purely temporary and contractual; may be extended based on requirement
Rs. 16000-1300-38000/- p.m. (consolidated, based on qualification and experience)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one qualification for the Assistant Project Manager post: a post graduate degree OR a graduate degree plus 03 years of relevant experience. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are also required. Hands-on experience in proficiency in MS Office and document management. Demonstrated ability in coordination, report writing, and independent handling of administrative responsibilities. Candidates having experience in PFMS, Finance & Accounts, Purchase & Project Management will be given preference. The age limit is maximum 32 years. The notice prints no date for counting age. It states the age relaxation as "50 years for employees working in projects and work assignment of IIT Kanpur". The notice does not name the degree subject. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary structure is in the range Rs. 16000-1300-38000/- p.m., based on qualification and experience. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period of one year. The notice says the period may be extended based on requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kanpur Assistant Project Manager
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to apply on the Google form link it gives. The last date for submission of the online application is 20 November 2026, up to 05:00 PM. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The R&D Office reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for shortlisting eligible candidates who satisfy the qualifications. Only short-listed candidates will be informed. The notice refers to an interview but gives no interview date, venue or mode.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be informed. Candidates with experience in PFMS, Finance & Accounts, Purchase & Project Management will be given preference.
